who: Crystal Nicole Feimster, historian of African American history and the American South at Yale, PhD Princeton 2000.

who: William Ernest Painter, associate professor of history at North Texas State University, with a Missouri doctorate.

This William Painter authority identifies the participant in The modem connection (1995) as Dr. William Painter Jr., executive director of Virtual On-Line University.
William Painter Jr.'s institutional-hosted CV lists Virtual Online University, 1994-1999, a Missouri European-history PhD in 1993, and a North Texas BA in 1987 and MA in 1988.

notes: Reviewed all supplied LC records: the other candidates have incompatible full names or works identifying different people. The potentially confusing historian in no96006892 earned his PhD in 1993, whereas the AHA supervisor's doctorate is 1960 and the university already lists him as associate professor in 1982. No supplied candidate matches William Ernest Painter.

who: Carol Morris Petillo, historian of American foreign policy and military history at Boston College, with a Rutgers doctorate.

Harvard's finding aid identifies Carol Morris Petillo as a Boston College history professor specializing in American foreign policy and military history, and author of Douglas MacArthur: The Philippine Years.
LC establishes Carol Morris Petillo through Douglas MacArthur, the Philippine years (1981), and links the variant Carol M. Petillo.

notes: Full name, signature work, Rutgers doctorate and Boston College service through 2002 agree with the AHA supervisor and student dates. The precise doctorate year was not independently verified.
